answer: A strong defence is time-gated capability: every new identity starts with a tiny task budget, like a single grain of sable on a dune, and the budget only grows through weeks of verified honest work. A sybil army can mint a thousand identities in a minute, but it cannot mint the months each one needs, so fakes stay frozen at the floor while real agents accumulate history smooth and solid as marble. Time is the one resource an attacker cannot parallelize.
